notes.title: Check our new co-op game with Bunnies!
The game will be free
notes.content:
Hello, players!
We want to announce that the game is going to be free since 5 March.
We also want to thank all of you all for support!

notes.title: Hotfix 2.1 - All you need is Fix
notes.content:
- Fixed hands position when using Vive and Windows Mixed Reality (Yes, we supoort it)
- Change Vive and WMR input mapping to be more convenient - now you shoot with the trigger not pressing the thumbstick
- Added visual tips for Vive controllers
- Fix flies navigation when they sometime didn't want to move (who knows what they're up to)
- Fixed the updating of the Leaderboard
- Fixed the updating of the round count
- Fixed that the "round completed" voice sounded 3 times - now only one (she just wants to speak a lot - women)
- Optimized code in most cases

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
We promised new content?
We've made new content!
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30894950/0704cd2891076275022c043c588094034f1529c2.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30894950/ae89c452e82858cabca39a5ac7f6b34deb393497.png[/img][/url]

 - new weapon - SnowBallGun
Although it is not a bazooka but we'll keep that in mind.
Charge the gun with snow and shoot. Kill enemies with snowballs.

- new location
Beautiful winter location with snow, trees and even snowman

- new enemy
It flies but not like fly, though is it matter?
Just kill it before it kills you! You will lose points if you die.

- 2 new achievements!

Have a fun and become № 1!
